page.layout: One page of text, single column, running head centred above the column; no margin notes; no page number printed.
page.notes: The running head is set in small capitals with letter spacing. Line-end hyphens in "Har-dervicena", "Lugdu-num", "in-terea" and "flo-rentissima" are kept as printed. The final word "Ve-" is a hyphenated line-end and continues on the next page. Some spacing irregularities in the print (e.g. "evocatus essem,in-") are reproduced as seen.
